passages.text: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
Some time passed.
David fought against the Philistines.
David defeated the Philistines.
David made the Philistines submit to him.
David took the city of Gath from the Philistines.
David also took the villages around Gath from the Philistines.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֛ח אֶת־ גַּ֥ת וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to David and brought him tribute.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David fought against the Moabites.
David defeated the Moabites.
The Moabites became servants to David.
The Moabites brought tribute to David.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֑ב וַיִּהְי֤וּ מוֹאָב֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֖י מִנְחָֽה׃

passages.text: As far as Hamath, David also defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah, who had marched out to establish his dominion along the Euphrates River.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
Hadadezer was king of Zobah.
Hadadezer marched out to the Euphrates River.
He wanted to establish his rule there.
David went as far as Hamath.
David defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ צוֹבָ֖ה חֲמָ֑תָה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהַצִּ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־ פְּרָֽת׃

passages.text: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David fought against King Hadadezer of Zobah.
David captured one thousand chariots from Hadadezer.
David also captured seven thousand charioteers.
David captured twenty thousand foot soldiers.
David hamstrung all the horses from the chariots.
David kept only one hundred horses for the chariots.
passages.original: וַיִּלְכֹּד֩ דָּוִ֨יד מִמֶּ֜נּוּ אֶ֣לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָרֶ֔כֶב וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב׃

passages.text: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
Hadadezer was king of Zobah.
The Arameans lived in Damascus.
The Arameans came from Damascus.
They came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah.
David fought against the Arameans.
David struck down twenty-two thousand Aramean men.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק לַעְז֕וֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus.
The Arameans became servants to David.
The Arameans brought tribute to David.
The LORD gave David victory everywhere he went.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק וַיְהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְדָוִ֔יד עֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

passages.text: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
Hadadezer was the king of Zobah.
Hadadezer had officers who served him.
These officers had gold shields.
David took the gold shields from the officers of Hadadezer.
David brought the gold shields to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗יד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ עַ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And from Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and various bronze articles.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
Hadadezer was king of Zobah.
Tibhath and Cun were cities ruled by Hadadezer.
David took a large amount of bronze from Tibhath and Cun.
Solomon was David’s son and became king after him.
Solomon used this bronze.
Solomon made the bronze Sea with it.
Solomon made the pillars with it.
Solomon made various bronze articles with it.
passages.original: וּמִטִּבְחַ֤ת וּמִכּוּן֙ עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֔זֶר לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד בָּ֣הּ׀ עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת־ יָ֤ם הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ וְאֶת־ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת כְּלֵ֥י הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ

passages.text: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah, he sent his son Hadoram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze, and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.
passages.sermon:
King Tou ruled Hamath.
Tou heard news about David.
David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer.
Hadadezer was king of Zobah.
Hadadezer had fought many wars against Tou.
Tou sent his son Hadoram to King David.
Hadoram came to greet David.
Hadoram came to bless David.
He blessed David because David fought Hadadezer.
David defeated Hadadezer.
Hadoram brought articles of gold, silver, and bronze.
King David took these articles.
David dedicated them to the LORD.
David also dedicated silver and gold from other nations.
He took treasures from Edom.
He took treasures from Moab.
He took treasures from the Ammonites.
He took treasures from the Philistines.
He took treasures from the Amalekites.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔יד אֶת־ כָּל־ חֵ֖יל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ צוֹבָֽה׃ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֶת־ הֲדֽוֹרָם־ בְּנ֣וֹ אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּ֠וִיד לִשְׁאוֹל ל֨וֹ לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרֲכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֙זֶר֙ וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ כִּי־ אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עוּ הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וְכֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ גַּם־ אֹתָ֗ם הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה עִם־ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ וְהַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשָׂ֖א מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מֵֽאֱד֤וֹם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵֽק׃

passages.text: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
passages.sermon:
Abishai was the son of Zeruiah.
He fought against the Edomites.
He struck down eighteen thousand Edomites.
This happened in the Valley of Salt.
passages.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֗ה הִכָּ֤ה אֶת־ אֱדוֹם֙ בְּגֵ֣יא הַמֶּ֔לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
passages.sermon:
David was king over Israel.
David placed garrisons in Edom.
All the Edomites became servants to David.
The LORD helped David.
The LORD gave David victory everywhere he went.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בֶּֽאֱדוֹם֙ נְצִיבִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֥וּ כָל־ אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑יד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder; Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was the scribe; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.
passages.sermon:
David was king over all Israel.
David ruled the whole nation.
David gave justice to all his people.
David did what was right for everyone.
Joab was the son of Zeruiah.
Joab led the army.
Jehoshaphat was the son of Ahilud.
Jehoshaphat was the recorder.
Zadok was the son of Ahitub.
Ahimelech was the son of Abiathar.
Zadok and Ahimelech were priests.
Shavsha was the scribe.
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Benaiah was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites.
David’s sons were the chief officials.
David’s sons served at the king’s side.
passages.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֗י עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃ וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־ הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃ וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְשַׁוְשָׁ֖א סוֹפֵֽר׃ וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל־ הַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וּבְנֵי־ דָוִ֥יד הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים לְיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ
